_comment: Flashcards de la Parte 4 del NIE.

cards.back: Intentional penile penetration of vagina, anus or mouth; no consent; no reasonable belief. Life.
cards.es: Penetración con el pene de vagina, ano o boca; sin consentimiento ni creencia razonable. Perpetua.

cards.back: Agrees by choice, with the freedom and capacity to make that choice.
cards.es: Acordar por elección con libertad y capacidad.

cards.back: Violence/fear (to B or another), unlawful detention, asleep/unconscious, physical disability, substance administered. Rebuttable; A must know.
cards.es: Violencia/miedo, detención ilegal, dormida, discapacidad física, sustancia. Refutables; A debe saberlo.

cards.back: Deception as to nature or purpose; impersonating a person known personally to B. Not rebuttable.
cards.es: Engaño sobre naturaleza o finalidad; suplantar a alguien conocido. No refutables.

cards.back: A continuing act from entry to withdrawal.
cards.es: Acto continuo desde la entrada hasta la retirada.

cards.back: All the circumstances, including steps A took to ascertain consent; voluntary intoxication doesn't help.
cards.es: Todas las circunstancias y medidas tomadas; la embriaguez voluntaria no sirve.

cards.back: Consent irrelevant; strict liability as to age (R v G).
cards.es: Consentimiento irrelevante; edad objetiva.

cards.back: Deceptions not about nature/purpose fall under s. 74, not s. 76.
cards.es: Otros engaños → s. 74.

cards.back: Penetration of vagina or anus with a body part or anything else; sexual; no consent; life. Not mouth.
cards.es: Vagina o ano con parte del cuerpo u objeto; sexual; perpetua. No boca.

cards.back: Intentional sexual touching without consent; either-way; 10 years.
cards.es: Tocamiento sexual sin consentimiento; either-way; 10 años.

cards.back: With any body part, with anything, through anything (clothing – R v H), incl. penetration.
cards.es: Con cualquier parte, objeto o a través de la ropa.

cards.back: (a) sexual by nature; or (b) may be sexual by nature and is sexual by circumstances/purpose.
cards.es: (a) sexual por naturaleza; (b) puede serlo y lo es por circunstancias/propósito.

cards.back: Causing B to engage in sexual activity without consent; life if penetration, else 10 years.
cards.es: Causar actividad sexual; perpetua si hay penetración, si no 10 años.

cards.back: Rape, penetration, sexual assault, causing/inciting. Consent irrelevant; strict liability on age.
cards.es: Consentimiento irrelevante; edad objetiva.

cards.back: No publication likely to identify the complainant, for life, from the moment the allegation is made.
cards.es: No publicar nada que identifique a la víctima, de por vida, desde la denuncia.

cards.back: Complainant 16+ gives written consent freely, or a court direction.
cards.es: Consentimiento escrito libre (16+) u orden judicial.

cards.back: Mouth swab / urine as early as possible; avoid eating, drinking, washing, toilet.
cards.es: Frotis bucal/orina pronto; no comer, beber, lavarse.

cards.back: Sexual Assault Referral Centre / Independent Sexual Violence Adviser.
cards.es: Centro de referencia de agresiones sexuales / asesor independiente.

cards.back: No evidence of complainant's sexual behaviour without the court's leave.
cards.es: Historial sexual solo con permiso del juez.

cards.back: Accused cannot cross-examine a sexual offence complainant in person.
cards.es: El acusado no interroga personalmente a la víctima.

cards.back: Complainants automatically eligible (intimidated witnesses); s. 28 pre-recorded cross-examination.
cards.es: Elegibles automáticamente; contrainterrogatorio pregrabado.

cards.back: A 18+; B under 16 with no reasonable belief 16+, or B under 13 (belief irrelevant).
cards.es: A 18+; B <16 sin creencia razonable, o <13.

cards.back: ss. 9–12 committed by a person under 18 – lower maximum (5 yrs ⚠).
cards.es: Si el autor es menor de 18.

cards.back: One prior meeting/communication + meet/travel/arrange (or B travels) + intent to commit sexual offence; B under 16.
cards.es: Una comunicación previa + quedar/viajar/organizar + intención.

cards.back: 18+, for sexual gratification, sexual communication with a child under 16. Max 2 years.
cards.es: Comunicación sexual con menor de 16 para gratificación.

cards.back: A 18+ in position of trust; B under 18. Sports coaches/religious leaders added 2022 ⚠.
cards.es: B <18; entrenadores y líderes religiosos desde 2022.

cards.back: Sexual activity with a child family member under 18.
cards.es: Menor de 18 de la familia.

cards.back: Take, make (download – Bowden), distribute, show, possess to distribute, advertise. Child = under 18. 10 yrs.
cards.es: Tomar, hacer (descargar), distribuir… 10 años.

cards.back: Possession of indecent photographs of a child – 5 yrs. Defences: legitimate reason, not seen/no cause to suspect, unsolicited.
cards.es: Posesión – 5 años; defensas.

cards.back: Any disorder or disability of the mind (MHA 1983 s. 1).
cards.es: Cualquier trastorno o discapacidad mental.

cards.back: Lacks capacity to choose (understanding of nature/consequences or any other reason), or unable to communicate choice.
cards.es: Sin capacidad para elegir o para comunicarlo.

cards.back: Capacity is person-, situation- and time-specific; irrational fear can remove it.
cards.es: Capacidad concreta; el miedo irracional puede anularla.

cards.back: B has capacity but agrees due to inducement, threat or deception.
cards.es: Incentivo, amenaza o engaño.

cards.back: Regular face-to-face care; consent/capacity irrelevant; exceptions: marriage or prior relationship.
cards.es: Cuidadores: consentimiento irrelevante.

cards.back: Administer/cause to be taken, knowing B doesn't consent, intending to stupefy/overpower for any person's sexual activity. 10 yrs.
cards.es: Administrar sustancia para aturdir; 10 años.

cards.back: Any offence with intent to commit a sexual offence; life if kidnapping/false imprisonment, else 10 yrs.
cards.es: Cualquier delito con intención sexual.

cards.back: Trespasser (knows/reckless) on premises intending a sexual offence there; intent can arise inside. 10 yrs.
cards.es: Intruso con intención sexual; 10 años.

cards.back: Any structure or part, incl. vehicles, vessels, tents ⚠.
cards.es: Incluye vehículos, barcos y tiendas.

cards.back: Offers/provides sexual services for payment on at least one occasion, compelled or not.
cards.es: Al menos una vez, obligada o no.

cards.back: Causing/inciting; controlling prostitution for gain. 7 yrs. Control needn't involve force (Massey).
cards.es: Causar/incitar; controlar con lucro; 7 años.

cards.back: Paying for sexual services of a prostitute subjected to force/threats/deception – strict liability, summary.
cards.es: Pagar a víctima explotada: objetiva.

cards.back: 18+, persistently (2+ in 3 months ⚠) loiters/solicits in street/public place.
cards.es: 18+, persistentemente.

cards.back: Soliciting in street/public place to obtain sexual services (buyer). No persistence.
cards.es: Cliente que solicita; sin persistencia.

cards.back: Premises used by more than one person for prostitution (SOA 1956 s. 33A – 7 yrs).
cards.es: Más de una persona.

cards.back: s. 47 paying; ss. 48–50 causing, controlling, arranging (child under 18).
cards.es: Menores de 18; víctimas.

cards.back: Intentionally exposes genitals intending someone sees and is caused alarm/distress. No one need see. 2 yrs.
cards.es: Exponer genitales con intención de alarmar; 2 años.

cards.back: Sending photo/film of genitals intending alarm/distress/humiliation, or for sexual gratification reckless as to that.
cards.es: Enviar foto de genitales.

cards.back: For sexual gratification: observe, operate equipment, record, install/adapt structure. 2 yrs.
cards.es: Observar, manejar, grabar, instalar.

cards.back: Place with reasonable expectation of privacy + genitals/buttocks/breasts exposed or in underwear, using lavatory, or sexual act.
cards.es: Privacidad + desnudo/ropa interior, baño o acto sexual.

cards.back: Beneath clothing, without consent, for sexual gratification or to humiliate/alarm/distress.
cards.es: Bajo la ropa; gratificación o humillación.

cards.back: Sharing intimate image without consent (base, no intent); aggravated with intent; threats to share. From 31/01/2024 ⚠.
cards.es: Compartir imagen íntima; amenazar.

cards.back: Animal; corpse; sexual activity in a public lavatory (summary).
cards.es: Animal, cadáver, baño público.
